theme: Light theme strictly. White-first interface, orange primary accent, slate text. Do NOT make it dark-theme-first. Main feel must remain light, clean, premium, operational, and emergency-ready.

headings.usage: Hero headers, big SOS numbers, major dashboard titles. Do NOT use Inter or Roboto.

body.usage: Data tables, queues, maps, input fields, body text. Distinct 1/l/I characters for high public-safety legibility.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70' with a 1px solid 'border-slate-200' for premium floating panels over maps. Do NOT use muddy gray transparency.
visual_enhancers.background_patterns: Use topographic/radar subtle SVG background patterns with 'opacity-5' on pure white containers to break up blank space.
visual_enhancers.borders_and_shadows: Use 1px 'border-slate-200' to structure the grid. Shadows should be soft, diffuse ambient shadows like 'shadow-sm' or 'shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]'.

citizen_portal.details: Generous touch targets ('p-6' to 'p-8'). Big map hero taking up 50vh, overlapping glass cards for risk analyzer and SOS trigger.

operator_desk.details: 12-column grid. Left/Top navigation, center map spanning full height, right-side fixed action panel for incoming live SOS queue. Tight gaps ('gap-4').

campus_desk.details: List-heavy view with fixed left sidebar. Clear offline banner indicators and sync badges.

components.sos_button: Hold-to-activate interaction. Use Framer Motion for a circular progress ring ('stroke-dashoffset') wrapping a glowing orange core. Add a heartbeat scale animation on hold.
components.risk_analyzer: Floating glass panel over the map. Use Recharts or concentric rings colored by risk level (Teal/Orange/Red) for floods/landslides.
components.voice_assistant: Floating action button in the bottom right with a pulsing ring animation when active.
components.offline_banners: Fixed top banner, 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-900', subtle pulse. 'Synced' state turns briefly green before disappearing.

motion.interactions: Hover states must explicitly change background and text color. Use 'whileTap' for buttons.
motion.state_changes: Use staggered entrance animations for the SOS queue to reduce cognitive load when multiple alerts arrive.

accessibility.contrast: Red text on light backgrounds must be dark enough (e.g., Red-600) to pass WCAG AA.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="sos-trigger-btn"').

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write all React code in .js using JSX syntax.
Use Shadcn UI components heavily but customize them to fit the clean, white-first, premium aesthetic. Do not use default Vercel look.
Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown MUST have 'bg-white' or 'bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md'.
Implement 'data-testid' on ALL inputs, buttons, and status elements.
Build a single unified React application using React Router to separate Citizen, Operator, and Campus desks, with a shared Login/Onboarding screen.
Generate dummy/fallback data for Kerala and Tamil Nadu districts (shelters, hospitals, colleges).
Implement a Language Context/Provider to switch between EN, TA, and ML.
Add Recharts for the risk analyzer and Leaflet (react-leaflet) for the live map routing.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Do not make generic centered layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Ensure pure white panels are separated by light slate borders or soft ambient shadows.
Make it look like a highly funded, deployment-ready emergency tech platform.
DO NOT apply universal transitions like 'transition: all'.
DO NOT center align the app container in App.css.
